note: Story County Conservation. Main campground on the north side of the 98-acre no-wake lake; a separate primitive campground on the south side has 11 sites with portable toilets. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 43 electric-only sites (50A), $23 + $4 per transaction, Apr-Oct, showers/flush/dump; added 2/3-night minimums, 14-night limit, Nov 1 booking. Imagery contradicts the stored 'behind a treeline' reasoning: lakeview lead.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD, UP to lakeview (stored 'not waterfront'): the note's 'behind a treeline buffer' is not what imagery shows. The south row of Breezy Bay (about 41.9925,-93.3612) faces the lake across open grass with only scattered trees; about 40-50 m pad to shoreline, scaled from an Esri frame. A park road/track runs along the shore between them, so not on-water under the loop-road rule, but the site-to-water ground is open and unscreened, which is the 'floor' for a *view. North and west rows are screened by the campground's own trees. No official campsite photo read. County page also names 'the dock along the shoreline at Hickory Grove Breezy Bay Campground'.

Imagery: the zoomed Esri frame shows the lake drained, with bare lakebed, and the wider frame shows it full. I did not find a statement of the lake's current level; storycountyiowa.gov answered a Cloudflare challenge to plain HTTP (not retried), so the park map and rules there stay unread.
Phone: entry has none. The mycountyparks pages read give the address (67464 250th St., Colo) but I did not capture a phone from them.

Second campground: the 11-site primitive campground on the south side is reservable only online; portable toilets, not an EKKO target, no entry needed. Pin 41.99250,-93.36050 is about 70 m south of the loop centre: fine.
